days.title: Look-back window (days)
days.description: How many past days of listing announcements to return. Between 1 and 30.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.description: Only return listings from these exchanges. Leave empty for all supported exchanges. Note: HTX uses the id `huobi`.

type.title: Listing type
type.description: Filter by market type: spot listings, futures (perpetual) listings, or both.

limit.title: Maximum items
limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return (newest first). Between 1 and 500.
